scenarioText: A bill on consumer protection has been debated. It now needs to be voted on to become a law. Who votes on this bill?
feedback: The Legislature must debate and vote to pass bills into laws.

scenarioText: A new road safety law was passed last month. Now it needs to be put into action across all states. Who does this work?
feedback: The Executive must implement and enforce laws passed by the Legislature.

scenarioText: The Health Ministry has drafted a bill on medical insurance. Who typically brings this bill to the Parliament for discussion?
feedback: The Executive introduces most bills in Parliament.

scenarioText: MPs want to know why unemployment is rising. They demand the Labour Minister explain government policies. Who has this questioning power?
feedback: The Legislature questions ministers in Parliament to keep a check.

scenarioText: A Parliamentary Committee is meeting to review education policies. The Education Ministry is called. Who must explain and provide data?
feedback: The Executive must provide information to Parliamentary Committees.

scenarioText: The finance minister presents a budget of ₹45 lakh crore for the next year. Before this money can be spent, who must approve it?
feedback: The Legislature must approve all government spending plans.

scenarioText: Experts are calculating budget allocations: ₹8 lakh crore for health, ₹12 lakh crore for education. Who prepares these calculations?
feedback: The Executive prepares the budget; The Legislature approves it.

scenarioText: After the budget is approved, ministries start spending. Who keeps watching to ensure money is spent properly and not misused?
feedback: The Legislature monitors spending to prevent misuse of public money.

scenarioText: Every day, government offices process passports, issue certificates, run schools and handle public services. Who manages these day-to-day tasks?
feedback: The Executive handles day-to-day government functioning independently.

scenarioText: It's time for the Budget Session to begin. Someone must advise the President to summon the Parliament. Who gives this advice?
feedback: The Executive advises the President to summon Parliament.
